import sys, json

       {"target":"e2","filter":"f","bind":{"x":"q","y":"p"}}]   # swapped binding
camp={"types":types,"modules":mods,"calls":[],"pipes":pipes,"entries":["e1","e2"],
      "machine":None,"runs":[]}
plans=kit.run(camp)["plans"]; print([ (p["entry"],p["flag"],p["variables"]) for p in plans])
runs=[]
